pins.title: Military tanks at Mile Zero Air Station
pins.note: Southern part of the air base on the island at the far south-west edge of the map. Drive through the gate or use the stunt jump beside the south-east entrance to clear the fence. Tanks are unlocked and can be entered directly. Taking one gives an instant 3-star wanted level and unlocks the Challenging Tank trophy. Too big to store in a garage. Approximate spot in Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island).

pins.title: Fighter jets at Mile Zero Air Station
pins.note: Parked around the airfield in the northern half of the same base. Same entry routes as for the tanks (gate or south-east stunt jump). Unlocked military jets. Stealing one triggers a 4-star wanted level and two military jets are sent after you. Approximate spot in Mile Zero Air Station (south-west island).

pins.title: Passenger jet at VCIA boarding gates
pins.note: Large airliner parked at a terminal boarding bridge; gates E3 and E4 are easiest to reach by getting through the airfield fence. Take off and get about 1 km away for the hidden Catch Me If You Can trophy. Airport jets carry trackers and bring a wanted level and fighter-jet pursuit. Approximate spot in Vice City International Airport (VCIA).

pins.title: Plane at Key Lento airstrip
pins.note: Small airstrip close to Jason's house. A taxi can fast-travel you straight to it. Unguarded plane with long fuel range, recommended for clearing the map fog. Stolen aircraft respawn at the same spot. Approximate spot in Key Lento.

pins.title: Helicopter on helipad east of Hamlet
pins.note: Helipad just east of Hamlet; helipads show an H icon on the zoomed-in map. Helicopter that can be taken without an airport wanted level. Approximate spot in Hamlet.

pins.title: Helicopter on hospital roof
pins.note: On the hospital roof; climb the ladder up to the pad. Does not spawn every time. Approximate spot in Vice City (hospital).

pins.title: Helicopters on skyscraper helipads
pins.note: Towers with an H helipad icon; walk into the lobby and ride the lift to the roof. A helicopter is almost always parked on marked helipads. Approximate spot in Vice City downtown towers.

pins.title: Helicopter on Ocean Beach hotel roof
pins.note: Rooftop helipad of a hotel in Ocean Beach. Rooftop helicopter spawn. Approximate spot in Ocean Beach.

pins.title: Helicopter and plane on Flamingo Island
pins.note: Flamingo Island, north of the city. Both a helicopter and a plane spawn here. Approximate spot in Flamingo Island (north of Vice City).

pins.title: Plane and helicopter at Port Gellhorn airstrip
pins.note: Airstrip just south of the town. One plane and one helicopter, unguarded. Approximate spot in South of Port Gellhorn.

pins.title: Helicopter north of Ambrosia
pins.note: Helipad/spawn north of the town of Ambrosia. Helicopter spawn. Approximate spot in North of Ambrosia.

pins.title: Zorrusso supercar (Randy mission)
pins.note: Walled parking garage of the Hathaway Apartments, ground level on the east side. Stolen in Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS for Randy; pays $21,250 plus a $10,000 condition bonus and gives the Key Cloner. Approximate spot in Ocean Beach - Hathaway Apartments.

pins.title: '67 Vapid Dominator Buggy (Ultimate Edition)
pins.note: Inside a garage in Grassrivers, shown with a purple map icon about one in-game day after the Chapter 2 mission Thrillbillies. Ultimate Edition car; also starts Wyman's classic-car rebuild questline (Find Cars for Wyman). Approximate spot in Grassrivers.

pins.title: '55 Vapid Stanier (Ultimate Edition)
pins.note: Parked at the roadside in Ocean Beach, purple icon appears soon after Chapter 3 Welcome to Vice City. Ultimate Edition classic car. Approximate spot in Ocean Beach.

pins.title: '95 Grotti Cheetah (Ultimate Edition)
pins.note: Drive down into the underground garage of Pegassi Residences, to the left of the lobby entrance. Marked after Chapter 5 Honest Abe. Ultimate Edition supercar. Approximate spot in Tequesta Retreat - Pegassi Residences.

pins.title: Shitzu Squalo speedboat (Ultimate Edition)
pins.note: Docked at Washington Beach. Ultimate Edition boat, only available during Chapter 4. Approximate spot in Washington Beach.

pins.title: Dinka Enduro bike and Crest Kayak (Ultimate Edition)
pins.note: At Jason's house after the first mission. Ultimate Edition dirt bike and kayak. Approximate spot in Key Lento - Jason's house.

pins.title: Hemming Rugger boat with free scuba gear
pins.note: On the docks of Leonida Bay. Boat that comes with scuba gear; handy for sea secrets such as the jet-ski dog event. Approximate spot in Leonida Bay docks.

pins.title: Randy's showroom and Wish List board
pins.note: Randy's car showroom; drive through the lot into the garage door to deliver. After Clonin' Keys he buys high-end Key Cloner cars; the Wish List board pays big for specific supercars (he gives tips one at a time). All deliveries give the Supply & Demand trophy. Approximate spot in Balsero.

pins.title: Moses' garage (sell stolen cars)
pins.note: Moses' garage in Port Gellhorn; cars can be taken from the main road through town. Buys stolen cars without trackers (scan them with WAiNK first) for $1,000+ each, roughly 2-minute cooldown. Unlocks in Chapter 2. Approximate spot in Port Gellhorn.

pins.title: Donnie's H&L .38 (missable unique revolver)
pins.note: In the trunk of Donnie's car parked by his trailer during the mission Don Gone. Open the trunk before you burn the car or the unique weapon variant is lost for good. Approximate spot in Key Lento - Donnie's trailer.

pins.title: Big Shots Ammu-Nation (expanded stock)
pins.note: Gun store in Hamlet; hover the map icon to confirm 'expanded'. Sells grenade launchers, the Hauners H-AT rocket launcher ($16,000) and sniper rifles. Approximate spot in Hamlet.

pins.title: Woodhatch Ammu-Nation (expanded stock)
pins.note: Gun store in Capri. Expanded store: launchers, rocket launcher and sniper rifles. Approximate spot in Capri.

pins.title: Phil's Ammu-Nation (expanded stock)
pins.note: Phil's gun store in Vice City. Expanded store: Hillinger Boomer ($12,000) and Deever Tech GLR40 ($15,500) grenade launchers, rocket launcher, snipers. Approximate spot in Vice City.

pins.title: Black Eagle Ammu-Nation (expanded stock)
pins.note: Gun store north-west of the city. Expanded store with heavy weapons and sniper rifles. Approximate spot in North-west of Vice City.

pins.title: Iron & Oak (expanded stock)
pins.note: Iron & Oak gun store in Vice City. Expanded store with heavy weapons and sniper rifles. Approximate spot in Vice City.

pins.title: Prestige Firearms (expanded stock)
pins.note: Prestige Firearms in Ocean Beach. Expanded store with heavy weapons and sniper rifles. Approximate spot in Ocean Beach.

pins.title: Parachute at Key Lento Ammu-Nation
pins.note: First gun store you visit in the story; parachutes hang on the back-left wall. Buy here, or ask any Ammu-Nation clerk for the Equipment section. Approximate spot in Key Lento.

pins.title: PTT Youngin$ compound (Ultimate Edition raid)
pins.note: Gang compound in Southside, marked with a yellow icon after Chapter 3 Boobie Time. Raid it and escape to grab special items and contraband. Ultimate Edition only. Approximate spot in Southside.

pins.title: Kirk's Skunk Ape flyer
pins.note: Flyer inside Skeeter's bar; read it to add Kirk to your contacts. Starts the Mr. Mangrove (Skunk Ape) Strangers & Freaks questline. Approximate spot in Hamlet - Skeeter's bar.

pins.title: Search for the Skunk Ape
pins.note: Kirk's truck in the swamps near Pelican River, night only. Follow him to a nesting site, a feeding spot and a clawed tree, then an effigy at the edge of the woods. You chase Mr. Mangrove but can't catch him; a giant boar charges you on the way back. Kirk pays $1,000. Approximate spot in Pelican River swamps.

pins.title: Tree Effigy #1
pins.note: North of the quest search zone, beside a lone tree in an open stretch of marsh. One of three effigies for Kirk's second quest (no cash reward). Approximate spot in Gullet Marsh (north of Pelican Valley).

pins.title: Tree Effigy #2
pins.note: Centre of the search zone, on a tree hidden behind dense bushes and saplings. Well-hidden effigy for Kirk's second quest. Approximate spot in Between Pelican Valley and Gullet Marsh.

pins.title: Tree Effigy #3
pins.note: In the trees and bushes north-west of the search zone. Creepy figure clutching its head with a knife in its chest; inspecting it ends the quest. Approximate spot in Gullet Marsh (north-west of search zone).

pins.title: Help Kirk Find Mr. Mangrove (finale)
pins.note: Board Kirk's helicopter at the lake; Mr. Mangrove collapses in the right-hand shack near the docks. Lucia only, night, Chapter 2+. Includes a frog-and-fly sequence and reveals Mr. Mangrove is Harry Sherrick, a man disfigured by swamp spores. Shooting him pays $10,000. Approximate spot in Cottonmouth Lake.

pins.title: Bigfoot open-world encounter
pins.note: Bigfoot feeds on a deer carcass beside the road south of Hamlet; chase him into the swamp to an effigy wrapped in green mist. Breathe in the mist to black out; Bigfoot inspects you before you wake nearby. Can't be caught or shot during this encounter. Approximate spot in Road south of Hamlet.

pins.title: UFO abduction event
pins.note: A few hundred metres from the Starlet Motel safehouse, look for a parked car facing a forest trail with its trunk open and lights flickering. Follow the trail to a blue light in a misty clearing. Night (most reliable after 2 AM), Chapter 2+. A UFO beams down a naked stranger; fetching their car brings the saucer overhead and unlocks The Truth Is Out There trophy. You wake 3 days later. Approximate spot in Rural roads east of Port Gellhorn (near Starlet Motel).

pins.title: Egg in a nest on the tallest TV tower
pins.note: Climb the tallest TV/radio tower in Vice City proper (around 6-7 minutes of climbing); the nest is at the very top. A literal Easter egg: take it and throw it off for a short cutscene. First shared on social media, also confirmed by Kotaku and GameSpot. Approximate spot in Vice City - tallest transmission tower.

pins.title: Imperial Spanish Ruins (WAiNK curiosity)
pins.note: Ruins near Moreau; scan them with the WAiNK app. One of 35 curiosity scan spots. Approximate spot in Moreau.

pins.title: Big Entrance (WAiNK curiosity)
pins.note: On Dalton Island in Vice Beach; scan with WAiNK. One of 35 curiosity scan spots. Approximate spot in Dalton Island, Vice Beach.

pins.title: Kenton's sunken treasure dive
pins.note: Kenton's beach shop in Key Lento; the boat takes you to a wreck in the Atlantic reached through an underwater trench. Find 3 gold chests on the seabed with the metal detector ($400); a shark shows up, use the harpoon. Starts the 33 underwater discoveries. Approximate spot in Key Lento - Island Dreams shop.

pins.title: Train-track police escape route (south-west Vice City)
pins.note: Drive along the train tracks at full speed when wanted. At 4+ stars police cars rarely spawn on the tracks; shoot pursuing helicopters to shake them. Approximate spot in South-west Vice City rail line.

pins.title: Train tunnel escape route (north Ambrosia)
pins.note: Rail tunnel north of Ambrosia. Same trick: follow the tracks to lose a high wanted level. Approximate spot in North Ambrosia train tunnel.

pins.title: Kingpin Bowling gang operation
pins.note: Bowling alley run by Kolts & Associates. Luxury watch in the south-east office, shotgun on the north-east table, safe in the north-east hallway. Bring sticky bombs for the safe; lose the cops afterwards for the Let's Go Bowling trophy. Approximate spot in Port Gellhorn.

pins.title: Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds
pins.note: Jewellery store in Vice City; use the Snap Gun on the back door and find the safe-code note. Suggested store for the undetected-robbery Sneakthief trophy. Payout about $4.5k-$12k. Approximate spot in Vice City.
